name: Don Alfonso 1890
address: The Westin Harbour Castle, 1 Harbour Sq., Toronto, M5J 1A6
dinnerNote: Signature tasting menu (meat-free Contemporary menu also $225)

menus.name: Signature tasting menu
menus.note: Six dishes plus canapés and petits fours. Premium wine pairing $200.

menus.name: Contemporary tasting menu
menus.note: Meat-free menu of six dishes plus canapés and petits fours. Premium wine pairing $200.

menus.name: à la carte menu
menus.note: A set price in the dining room for dishes chosen from the antipasti, pasta and main courses.

bookingOpens: Online on OpenTable, linked from the restaurant's website, or by phone.
cancellation: A valid credit card is needed to confirm the booking. Cancelling with less than 48 hours' notice costs $100 a person.
walkIns: A lounge serves its own menu of small plates, pasta and desserts ($18–34 a dish).
groups: The dining room on the 38th floor can be booked for private events: up to 82 seated or 120 standing, on Mondays and Tuesdays for lunch or dinner, or for lunch from Wednesday to Sunday. Events team: events@donalfonsotoronto.com, +1 416-214-5888.
